official.deadline_central_display: Spring 2027 and Summer 2027 scholarships: October 1 - November 1, 2026. Fall 2027 and 2027-2028 academic year scholarships: February 1 - March 1, 2027.
official.deadline_note: Application deadlines are subject to change; applicants are told to begin researching well in advance and to always check the criteria and due dates in the application.
official.application_cycle: Two cycles per year: Fall/Academic Year scholarships (February 1 - March 1) and Spring/Summer term scholarships (October 1 - November 1)
official.status_note: Applications for Spring 2027 and Summer 2027 scholarships are being accepted October 1 - November 1, 2026; the Fall 2027 / 2027-2028 academic year cycle opens February 1, 2027.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Published wording: "The general financial aid awarded by ISSS does not provide a waiver of the nonresident portion of a student's tuition & fee bill." Only TAMS, the African Leadership Bridge award and the Good Neighbor Scholarship touch tuition, and those are waivers or exemptions rather than cash.
official.funding_period: one-time award per semester or academic year
benefits: Named one-time cash awards of $2,000-$5,000: Carlos and Clara Quintanilla $5,000, Ethel Loving de Diaz $4,500, STEM Scholarship $4,800, SIAWE $3,500, Jerry D. Wilcox $3,500, Iimura Peace $5,000, Khalid Alhilali $2,500 and Dr. David Nilsson $2,000
African Leadership Bridge Endowed Scholarship: $5,000 academic year award ($2,500 fall, $2,500 spring) combined with a waiver of the nonresident portion of tuition
Tuition Assistance for Mexican Students (TAMS): waiver of the nonresident portion of the tuition bill - not a cash award

Good Neighbor Scholarship: exemption of one year's tuition (fall, spring and summer) for eligible students born in and resident of a Western Hemisphere nation, administered for the Texas Higher Education Coordinating Board
General ISSS Financial Aid: competitive need-based cash scholarship for students who have completed two semesters at UT Austin
eligibility: Enrolled full-time at UT Austin during the award semester (most awards)
Completed an entire course of study for two academic semesters at UT Austin (General ISSS Financial Aid, SIAWE, Jerry D. Wilcox, African Leadership Bridge)
Minimum cumulative GPA set per award, ranging from 2.0 to 3.75
Demonstrated financial need for the need-based awards
Country or region-of-origin conditions for the Quintanilla, Nilsson, SIAWE, TAMS, Good Neighbor, African Leadership Bridge, Iimura Peace, Khalid Alhilali and STEM awards
requirements: Apply through LASSO, the university-wide scholarship system, using the keyword search "ISSS"
Answer questions about estimated annual expenses as part of the application
Write essays related to the scholarship's intent or your own experiences and background
Meet all eligibility criteria for the specific scholarship you are applying for
Iimura Peace recipients must complete a service project within one year of receiving the scholarship
documents: Completed LASSO scholarship application found by keyword search "ISSS"
Essays related to the scholarship's intent or the applicant's own experiences and background
UT Austin enrolment record proving full-time status and completed semesters
selection_criteria: Awards are competitive and the number allotted per semester is limited
Scholarships are one-time awards and recipients are not guaranteed to receive them in subsequent years

Award-specific preferences apply, e.g. first-generation status and work-funding experience (Ethel Loving de Diaz), incoming first-year students (African Leadership Bridge), matriculation from a high school or university in Monterrey or other Mexican cities (STEM), and Tejupilco or Queretaro (Dr. David Nilsson)
coverage: One-time cash awards ranging from USD 2,000 to USD 5,000 per award
Tuition Assistance for Mexican Students: waiver of the nonresident portion of tuition, not a cash award
Good Neighbor Scholarship: exemption of one year's worth of tuition (fall, spring and summer), excluding fees and charges such as health insurance and the ISSS Support Services fee
African Leadership Bridge: $5,000 academic year award with a nonresident tuition waiver, split $2,500 fall and $2,500 spring
application_method: Log in to LASSO with a UT Austin account
Search for scholarships using the keyword "ISSS"
Open the desired application and click "Start Application" or "Continue Application"
Submit before the deadline for that cycle
official.application_route: Apply through LASSO (the university-wide scholarship system) using the keyword "ISSS" during the twice-yearly application windows.
official.study_mode: Full-time enrollment during the award semester
official.citizenship_residency: Open to international students; several awards are restricted by nationality or region of origin (Mexico, Iran, Middle East, East Asia or Asia, African continent, Western Hemisphere)
official.international_eligibility: Yes - these scholarships exist specifically for international students at UT Austin
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Field restrictions on some awards: Cockrell School of Engineering (Quintanilla, STEM), Dell Medical School or College of Natural Sciences with listed exclusions (STEM), and high-school-origin conditions (Nilsson, Khalid Alhilali, Iimura Peace)
official.duration: One-time awards for the semester or academic year in which they are granted; recipients are not guaranteed the scholarship in subsequent years
official.description: Texas Global's International Student and Scholar Services administers a set of scholarships for enrolled international students at UT Austin - named one-time awards from $2,000 to $5,000, need-based cash aid, and tuition waivers or exemptions - applied for twice a year through the LASSO system.

verification.notes: Per-award amounts, eligibility rules, application windows and the LASSO "ISSS" keyword process were read directly from the Texas Global ISSS Scholarships and Financial Services page on 2026-10-10. The maximum published one-time award ($5,000) is recorded as the funding figure with the full per-award breakdown preserved in benefits; General ISSS Financial Aid and the IEF Scholarship publish no amounts.

applicant_utility.summary: These are one-time awards for students already enrolled at UT Austin, and most require two completed semesters at UT - so first-semester new arrivals qualify for almost nothing here. Applications run twice a year through LASSO under the keyword "ISSS": October 1 to November 1 for spring/summer terms, February 1 to March 1 for fall and the academic year. Amounts run $2,000 to $5,000 depending on the named award, and if you win cash, expect 14% withheld for U.S. tax unless a treaty applies.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Continuing international undergraduates and graduates at UT Austin with at least two completed semesters who match a specific award's country, region-of-origin or financial-need criteria.
application_readiness_checklist: Search LASSO for "ISSS" as soon as each window opens - the applications only exist during the two windows
Map your nationality or region to the awards that fit (Mexico, Iran, Middle East, East Asia or Asia, Africa, Western Hemisphere)
Check whether your programme is formula-funded (Option I) - Option III students are not eligible for General ISSS Financial Aid
Pre-draft essay answers on the specific scholarship's intent and your background before the window opens
Confirm your cumulative GPA clears the specific award's 2.0-3.75 threshold
common_rejection_risks: Applying as a first-semester student when most awards require two completed UT semesters
Applying for General ISSS Financial Aid as an Option III student
Missing that this page covers a dozen distinct scholarships with different rules - read your specific award's criteria
Forgetting the Iimura Peace service-project obligation that follows an award
Assuming a win renews - these are explicitly one-time awards
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Cash awards are applied first to any outstanding UT debts, and 14% is withheld for tax unless a treaty applies; tuition waivers and exemptions exclude fees such as health insurance and the ISSS Support Services fee.
document_audit: Essays must address the specific scholarship's intent, not your general background
Estimated annual expense figures are requested inside the application - assemble them in advance
Enrolment records must prove full-time status and completed semesters
alerts: The Good Neighbor Scholarship covers tuition only - no fees, health insurance or ISSS Support Services fee
TAMS waives only the nonresident portion of tuition and is competitive with limited awards
The nearest window is Spring/Summer 2027, closing November 1, 2026
Deadlines are subject to change - verify inside LASSO itself before relying on them
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Log in to LASSO with your UT EID, search "ISSS", complete the application and essays inside the window, and compete for the limited per-semester awards.
